decision.reason: [ev-3ade4dee13c7] is a single highlights bullet. It only says that a `CancelHealthCheckOnNewRevision` feature gate exists in kustomize-controller. It doesn't give the gate's default state (opt-in or enabled by default), what the gate does, or what conditions would expose an environment, so the applicability condition can't be written. We need a source such as the kustomize-controller changelog, docs or the PR that gives the default value and describes the behaviour.
